caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a long-handled wooden ladle. The ladle has a rounded, cup-shaped bowl at one end, made of wood in various shades of brown with visible grain lines and a gray metallic band encircling the opening of the bowl. The straight, slender handle also appears to be wooden and extends from the bowl, ending with a decorative, bulbous finial and a small knob at the opposite end. The ladle is oriented diagonally from the lower left to the upper right of the composition, set against a plain beige or off-white background. The overall composition is sparse, with the ladle as the sole subject and no additional objects or scenery. A small, faint rectangular mark with the number "11" is present near the lower right area of the background.
title: Toddy Ladle
